channel.title: Kestrel updates
channel.description: Signed Kestrel preview updates for Apple silicon.

item.description:
# Kestrel 1.7.1 — Newly installed apps appear automatically

Kestrel now refreshes its app list in the background whenever you open the launcher, and every five seconds while it stays visible. Apps installed after Kestrel starts—including apps inside Applications subfolders—appear without restarting or using Refresh applications. Renamed and removed apps are updated too.

The previous list stays available while refreshing, so typing remains responsive. Search results update when a changed list is ready. App discovery reads the Applications folders directly and does not wait for Spotlight indexing.

## Update

Choose **Check for Updates…** in the wing menu or General settings. Automatic checks notify you; installation asks first. Settings, snippets, and clipboard history remain in place.

Official builds retain the signing identity introduced in 1.7.0. Users upgrading directly from 1.6.1 or earlier may need the [one-time Full Disk Access refresh](https://github.com/junoh-bg/kestrel/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md#one-time-permission-refresh-for-170). Full Disk Access was retained in our signed-update test; this does not guarantee that macOS will permit the app to open without a separate security approval.

## macOS may ask to allow Kestrel again

If macOS blocks opening Kestrel, use **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway** for a trusted download, then authenticate and confirm **Open**. See the [first-launch guide](https://github.com/junoh-bg/kestrel/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md#first-launch). This app-opening approval is separate from Full Disk Access. The persistent certificate keeps the app identity consistent; it does not provide Apple Developer ID or notarization, so we cannot promise warning-free updates. Do not disable Gatekeeper. If the message says malware was detected or the app is damaged, stop and report it.

Apple silicon · macOS 14+ · build 14 · preview. This app is self-signed, not Apple-notarized; the initial installation warning remains.

# Kestrel 1.7.0 — Nested search and lasting permissions

Find files and folders using paths such as `dev/docs`, `kestrel/docs/demo`, or a partial final name like `dev/do`. Home (`~/`) and absolute paths work too; add a trailing `/` to show only folders. Searches use Spotlight and your existing macOS permissions.

Official builds now keep a consistent signing identity across updates, helping macOS retain your privacy permissions.

## Existing users: one-time Full Disk Access approval

**When upgrading from 1.6.1 or earlier, users who enabled Full Disk Access may need to approve Kestrel once more.** The app is moving from its old signature to a persistent identity. Your settings, snippets, and clipboard history stay in place.

If protected-folder search stops working after updating:

1. Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Full Disk Access**.
2. Remove the old **Kestrel** entry from this permission list, then use **+** to add **/Applications/Kestrel.app** and enable it. Authenticate if asked. This removes only the permission entry—not the app or your data.
3. Choose **Quit & Reopen**, then check **Kestrel Settings → Search → Check access**.

Future official updates using this identity are intended to retain the approval. This was confirmed through a real Sparkle update on macOS 27.0.1; other Macs and older supported macOS versions still need verification. Locally built ad-hoc apps have a different identity and may need approval again.

Full Disk Access remains optional. Apps, Google search, the calculator, and snippets work without it. You do not need to install a certificate or create any signing keys.

## Update

From **1.6.0 or later**, choose **Check for Updates…** in the wing menu or General settings. Automatic checks notify you; you choose when to install. **1.5.0 and earlier** need one manual replacement using the app ZIP.

## Compatibility

Apple silicon · macOS 14+ · build 13 · preview. Self-signed and **not Apple-notarized**; the initial macOS installation warning remains. Follow the [first-launch guide](https://github.com/junoh-bg/kestrel/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md#first-launch) for a trusted download. Separate-Mac and macOS 14 acceptance remain unverified.

# Kestrel 1.6.1 — Settings readability fix

Fixed hard-to-read checkbox labels in **Settings → General** and **Settings → Clipboard**, including “Check automatically.” Labels now use the selected theme's text color consistently.

All five Settings sections were reviewed across all five themes. Added pixel-level checks for checked, unchecked, and disabled checkbox labels under both legacy and current macOS rendering paths.

## Update

From Kestrel 1.6.0, choose **Check for Updates…** in the wing menu or General settings, then approve installation. Version 1.5.0 and earlier need one manual app replacement. Saved settings and snippets remain in place.

## Compatibility

Apple silicon, macOS 14+, build 12. This preview remains ad-hoc signed and **not Apple-notarized**. Follow the [first-launch guide](https://github.com/junoh-bg/kestrel/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md#first-launch) if macOS blocks a trusted download. Separate-Mac and macOS 14 acceptance remain unverified.
